title: Stonebridge Collections — Raw-materials-derived policy
brief_text: This instruction is assembled from a policy memo and an operations update. Follow the newest explicitly applicable rule where the documents conflict, but flag unresolved conflicts rather than inventing a rule. Verify the caller before disclosure. Record a promise only after checking current product-specific constraints and obtaining the customer's explicit agreement. If a debt is disputed, use the dispute path and do not record a promise for that disputed product. Tool results are authoritative for whether an operation succeeded; a spoken confirmation is not proof of a ledger change.
notes: Tests extraction from conflicting/dated source materials. The builder must preserve provenance and flag ambiguity.
